text:
If your Friday plans have felt more like November than October, the sky is telling the truth: light rain and a chilly 63 degrees are the story right now, with temperatures unlikely to make much of the advertised mid 60s. The front is still working through, so expect showers to hang on into the afternoon, then taper before 5. A northwest breeze and damp air will keep it feeling raw, even as the rain fades. On the lake, north winds and waves building tonight make this a good day to stay close to shore.

The payoff arrives tonight, with clouds breaking and temperatures slipping toward 50. Saturday looks like the reset button, full sunshine, a high near 59, and a crisp north breeze. I’d keep the rain gear handy through late afternoon, then plan for a dry, jacket-worthy evening and a beautiful Saturday outdoors.
